mechanism: Furosemide-induced hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia increase risk of QT prolongation and arrhythmias, which are also associated with antipsychotic use; additive orthostatic hypotension and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, magnesium) regularly, maintain adequate supplementation, monitor ECG for QT prolongation, and assess blood pressure and orthostatic symptoms.
